title: Software Developer Trainee
description:
**Job Title: Software Developer Trainee**
 We are looking for enthusiastic
 **Software Developer Trainees** 
 who are passionate about programming, problem\-solving, and building real\-world applications.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* Strong programming fundamentals
* Hands\-on experience with any programming language — C, C\+\+, Java, C\#, Python, JavaScript, PHP, Go, or similar
* Good logical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Basic understanding of databases and SQL
* Familiarity with APIs and client\-server architecture (preferred, but not required)
* Willingness to learn and contribute to real\-world software projects


**Learning Path \& Training Focus**
 We provide a structured, hands\-on training program where you’ll progress from foundational concepts to real\-world development:
   

  

* Go (Golang) is the primary backend language used in our projects, and you’ll receive full training to become proficient — no prior Go experience is required.
* Begin with Go fundamentals (syntax, concurrency, standard library)
* Move into building RESTful APIs, microservices, and backend systems
* Apply your learning through guided projects and real\-world code contributions


**What You’ll Gain Exposure To**
* Backend application development using Go
* RESTful API design and implementation
* Database integration (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB)
* Git and collaborative version control workflows
* Debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
* Code reviews and industry best practices
* End\-to\-end development of real\-world software projects


**Who Can Apply?**
 Recent graduates and freshers from any of the following backgrounds:
   

  

* B.E./B.Tech
* B.Sc. (Computer Science / IT / related fields)
* BCA
* MCA
* M.Sc. (Computer Science / related fields)
* Other relevant technical degrees


 Preference will be given to candidates with academic projects, personal projects, GitHub contributions, or any prior hands\-on programming experience — but these are not required to apply.
   

  

**Our Philosophy**
 We value
 **programming fundamentals, logical thinking, learning agility, and passion for software development** 
 far more than prior experience with a specific language.
   

  

 If this sounds like you — we’d love to hear from you! Interested candidates can apply by sharing their resume or GitHub profile with us.
   

  

 Skills: fundamentals,learning,basic
